values.quote: 20% of ''Eye of the Storm's'' cooldown is refunded

mechanics.claim: The shield grants bonus attack damage to the target for as long as the shield holds, which changes damage dealt by the shielded ally (relevant if the shield is on self or an ally attacking the dummy).
mechanics.quote: While the shield holds, the target gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The shield itself reduces damage taken while it holds (a flat absorb), a defensive effect.
The cooldown refund only triggers when a Janna ability slows or knocks up at least one enemy champion, once per cast.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Janna's''' abilities {{tip|slow}} or {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, 20% of ''Eye of the Storm's'' cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.

mechanics.claim: Allied turrets shielded by Eye of the Storm also gain the bonus attack damage.
mechanics.quote: Allied turrets will benefit from the bonus attack damage when targeted by ''Eye of the Storm''.
